data.narrative:
Tenna Systems is a Seed-stage Defense & Security company that has raised $13.5M to date. The peer universe comprises 10 comparable companies: 2 public (DRSHF, IDEAFORGE.NS) and 8 private firms including UFORCE, Anduril Industries, Helsing, Shield AI, and Saronic, which span Seed through Series A stages.

Two triangulation methods were applied. Stage-Progression uses the $13.5M raised as a value proxy and applies a 2.5x multiplier typical of Seed-to-next-stage advancement, yielding $34M. Peer-Median leverages three same-sector, same/adjacent-stage comparables (UFORCE at $1.0B, Singularity at $400M, NODA AI at $125M), producing a median valuation of $400M and a range of $125M–$1.0B. The wide peer dispersion reflects substantial heterogeneity in Defense & Security funding outcomes and investor conviction at early stages.

The two methods triangulate to a range of $29M–$460M, with a median of $217M. The wide band reflects material uncertainty around (1) the applicable peer cohort given sector complexity, (2) the stage-progression multiplier's relevance for frontier defense companies, and (3) market differentiation relative to established players. Stage-Progression anchors conservatively; Peer-Median suggests considerably higher value. Further clarity on product-market fit, customer traction, and defensibility would narrow this range materially.
